summary: The current advice is to wait before buying anything in India, though Hindustan Copper is the preferred choice if investing, and to buy JPMorgan Chase in the United States. Analysts are discussing how fees and taxes on a ten thousand rupee trade in India add up to about thirty-eight rupees plus twenty percent tax on short-term gains. They are also debating whether companies like State Bank of India and Finolex Cables are too risky or expensive right now.
